findings.description: Legacy status writer completes preparation without checklist; later auto-accept mutation is not persisted.
Manager cannot approve this completed gate; review requires SUBMITTED.
Submission preview considers bare legacy Done eligible; merely restoring the submit button would submit missing evidence.
Rejected sealed draft returns HTTP 200 and success:true with saved:0 plus an error; client currently treats HTTP success as saved.

limitations: Mocked persistence does not prove database isolation, actual race timing, full RBAC or browser behaviour.
These probes intentionally confirm defects in the audited source. Replace with desired-behaviour integration tests in implementation.
